title: Input index precedes the next block
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine, and let $N,T,t\in\mathbb N$. For every $p\in\mathbb N$ with $p<N+2$, the index $t\bigl(k(2T+1)+N+3\bigr)+k(2T+1)+p$ is strictly less than $(t+1)\bigl(k(2T+1)+N+3\bigr)$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state multi-tape Turing machine M
Natural numbers N, T, and t
A natural number p satisfying p<N+2
